source.title: Tomasz Zolnowski wins European Championship 2008
source.content:
[Tomasz Zolnowski](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005ZOLN01) won the [European Championship 2008](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2008) with an average of 11.71 seconds. [Erik Akkersdijk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005AKKE01) finished second (12.15) and [Edouard Chambon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2004CHAM01) finished third (12.47).
 World records: Erik Akkersdijk 5x5x5 1:18.59 (single), Edouard Chambon 2x2x2 3.43 (average), Maté Horvath Master Magic 1.95 (average).
 European records: Rafal Guzewicz 4x4x4 blindfolded 7:54.35, 5x5x5 blindfolded 16:15.

translation.title: Tomasz Zolnowski 夺得 2008 年欧洲锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Tomasz Zolnowski](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005ZOLN01) 以 11.71 秒的平均成绩赢得[2008 年欧洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2008)冠军。[Erik Akkersdijk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005AKKE01) 以 12.15 秒获得亚军，[Edouard Chambon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2004CHAM01) 以 12.47 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Erik Akkersdijk，五阶单次 1:18.59；Edouard Chambon，二阶平均 3.43 秒；Maté Horvath，十二板平均 1.95 秒。

欧洲纪录：Rafal Guzewicz，四盲 7:54.35、五盲 16:15。
